list.title: Orders
list.description: Orders placed to your organization and orders it placed to its supplier.
list.forbidden: You need the order read permission to see orders.
list.date_invalid: The end date is before the start date; the date filter is ignored.
list.empty_description: Orders appear here once they are created.
form.title: New order
form.description: Pick products from the catalog and enter the amounts. Prices come from your supplier's price list.
form.forbidden: You need the order write and catalog read permissions, and an organization with a supplier, to place an order.
form.errors.quantity_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1,000,000.
form.errors.meters_invalid: Enter a length above 0 with at most 2 decimals.
form.errors.too_many: An order can have at most 200 lines.
form.price_rule: Prices are set by the server from your supplier's price list and frozen with the exchange rate when the supplier approves the order.
form.save_failed: The order could not be saved.
detail.title: Order
detail.history_on_behalf: By the seller on behalf of the buyer
actions.failed: The action could not be completed.
actions.submit.title: Submit the order?
actions.submit.description: The order is sent to your supplier for approval and can no longer be edited.
actions.approve.title: Approve the order?
actions.approve.description: Line prices are fetched again and locked, and the exchange rate is frozen.
actions.reject.title: Reject the order?
actions.reject.description: The order is cancelled and the buyer sees your reason.
actions.start_preparing.title: Start preparing?
actions.start_preparing.description: Scan the barcodes of the units to ship for each line; they are reserved for this order.
actions.mark_ready.title: Mark the order ready to ship?
actions.mark_ready.description: Every line is covered by assigned units.
actions.ship.title: Ship the order?
actions.ship.description: The assigned units leave your stock and are in transit to the buyer.
actions.receive.title: Receive the shipment?
actions.receive.description: All shipped units are added to your stock and the purchase is posted to your books.
actions.receive_on_behalf.button: Received on behalf of the buyer
actions.receive_on_behalf.title: Receive on behalf of the buyer?
actions.receive_on_behalf.description: The buyer has no member who signs in. The shipped units move to the buyer's stock, the sale is posted to both accounts and the history notes "on behalf of the buyer".
actions.receive_on_behalf.success: Order received on behalf of the buyer.
actions.cancel.title: Cancel the order?
actions.cancel.description: Reserved units are released. This cannot be undone.
actions.request_cancel.title: Request cancellation?
actions.request_cancel.description: The order is already shipped. It is cancelled once the supplier confirms the goods are back.
actions.complete_cancel.title: Complete the cancellation?
actions.complete_cancel.description: Confirm that the shipped units are back; they return to your stock.
assign.hint: Scan or type the barcode of each unit to ship. Fixed barcodes take a quantity; rolls take meters: leave it empty for the whole roll, fewer meters split the roll under a new barcode.
assign.complete: Every line is covered. You can mark the order as ready.
assign.not_complete: Assign units to every line first.
assign.failed: The unit could not be assigned.
assign.split_success: Roll split: new barcode {{barcode}}, {{rest}} m left on the roll.
suggest.title: Barcode suggestion
suggest.rule: Units placed in a bin first, then the oldest entry (FIFO). For rolls the roll covering the requested meters is chosen.
suggest.empty: No suitable unit for this line.
suggest.failed: The suggestion could not be applied.
shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.receipt_too_large: The file can be at most 10 MB.
shipping.receipt_failed: The delivery receipt could not be uploaded.
shipping.download_failed: The document could not be downloaded.
shipping.regenerate_failed: The shipping note could not be generated.
delivery_methods.title: Delivery methods
delivery_methods.description: Carriers and delivery methods chosen when shipping orders. Warehouse pickup is the system method and cannot be changed.
delivery_methods.name: Name
delivery_methods.save_failed: The delivery method could not be saved.
delivery_methods.delete_failed: The delivery method could not be deleted.
center_form.title: New order for a dealer
center_form.dealer_none: No dealer under the center found.
center_form.warehouse_hint: The order falls into this warehouse; picking suggestions and warehouse notifications follow it.
center_form.self_prepare: I will prepare this order myself
center_form.self_prepare_hint: No new order notification goes to the warehouse staff; you prepare and dispatch the order yourself.
center_form.price_rule: The order opens approved and goes to the warehouse. The unit price is the dealer's list price less the discount; without a list price the price you type applies, or 0 when there is none, and the line is flagged. Gift lines are 0.
center_form.price_missing_warning: Some lines have no price; they were saved as 0.
form.errors.price_invalid: Unit price must be 0 or more, with at most 4 decimals.
actions.deliver.title: Mark the order as delivered?
actions.deliver.description: Records a hand or depot delivery. The stock moves to the dealer when they receive it. You can add a delivery note.
actions.deliver.success: The order was marked as delivered.
invoice.empty: No invoice record for this order yet.
invoice.mark_description: Enter the number and date of the invoice you issued and pick the lines it covers.
invoice.mark_failed: The invoice record could not be saved.
invoice.remove_confirm: This invoice record and its line marks will be removed. Continue?
invoice.remove_failed: The invoice record could not be removed.
actions.back_to_preparing.title: Reopen preparation?
actions.back_to_preparing.description: Assigned units stay on the order; add or remove barcodes, then mark it ready again.
actions.back_to_preparing.success: The order is being prepared again.
scan.label: Scan barcode
scan.hint: The scanned barcode is assigned to the first open line of its product.
scan.no_line: No line awaiting assignment for this product: {{product}}
center_form.discount_none: No discount is set for this dealer.
center_form.total_try: In TRY at the current rate (1 {{currency}} = {{rate}} TRY, {{date}})
form.errors.discount_invalid: The discount must be between 0 and 100 with at most 2 decimals.
discounts.title: Dealer discounts
discounts.description: Set the standard discount agreed with the dealer and the discount of its first order. The order screen applies these rates by default.
discounts.forbidden: Viewing dealer discounts needs permission to write prices.
discounts.buyer_none: No dealer found under your organization.
discounts.standard_hint: Applies to every order. Leave empty for no discount.
discounts.first_order_hint: Replaces the standard discount on the dealer's first order only.
discounts.state_first: The dealer has not ordered yet; the next order gets the first-order discount.
discounts.state_placed: The dealer has placed orders; the standard discount applies.
edit_lines.title: Edit lines
edit_lines.hint: Add products, change amounts or remove lines. A new line is priced from the price list. Removing a line with assigned barcodes frees them.
edit_lines.failed: The lines could not be updated
edit_lines.below_assigned: Cannot go below the assigned amount; unassign a barcode first.
plotter.label: Sent plotter cut
plotter.failed: The plotter mark could not be saved
